result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers ship working defaults and give a practical week plan. A also sorts the options into automatic, default, setting and cut groups, and it explicitly covers applying changes immediately with Undo and per-group reset to defaults. B never addresses rubric item 4 (instant changes and easy revert), and its 'cut' bucket is only implied, though its plan is a little tighter for one week. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give working defaults, sort options into automatic and real settings, and include a week plan. A is tighter and a bit better scoped to one week, but it never says how setting changes take effect or how to revert them.
